report.scope: Exact matmul device fatbin equality includes all kernel instructions and resource descriptors; host selector differs only for gfx1030 MXFP6 M1 K6144 N5120. Whole executables are different.

Exact matmul device fatbin equality includes all instructions and resources. C changes only host prepare-time MXFP6 selection: gfx1030 5120<K<10240 and gfx1201 N1024 K<5120 use old ID20. On actual six MTP shapes routes match A except gfx1030 MXFP6 O, which matches B. Whole executables differ.

b_nearby.note: B near-scope observations remain historical and are excluded from final C selection unless explicitly selected by C.
